title: Robust Bias Detection in MLMs and its Application to Human Trait Ratings

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the association between gendered words (including non-binary neo-pronouns) and personality/character trait target words in Masked Language Models and Autoregressive Language Models. This uses sentence templates evaluated via pseudo-log-likelihood and a mixed-effects model to account for random template and word variability.
Evaluating pseudo-log-likelihood (PLL) score differences between stereotypical and anti-stereotypical sentences from the crowdsourced CrowS-Pairs dataset using a mixed-effects model.
